text: Enter XSS string <script>alert('XSS')</script> in comment field and ensure tag doesn't execute
Submit long HTML text in form, verify it displays as text, not HTML
Verify that when CSRF token is tampered in order form server returns 403
Reuse old csrf-token from different session, ensure request is blocked
Verify ajax requests to external domains prohibit cookie sending (SameSite policy)
Test cookies with Secure=true, HttpOnly=true and SameSite=Strict flags on protected pages
Verify account deletion permanently removes all personal data (GDPR Right to Erasure)
Send contact form request with fake email, ensure email doesn't appear in server logs
For unauthorized user load profile page — personal data should not be visible
Verify cookie information page exists with withdraw consent option (GDPR)
Accept cookies, reload page, verify consent banner no longer displays
Try sending request with unauthorized geolocation — ensure personal coordinates not saved
Enter personal data in form, ensure public API response doesn't return it
Verify no sensitive tokens remain in URL after password reset
Send injection attempt via URL parameter (e.g., sql), ensure request handled securely
On login page test login attempt limit (brute force protection)
Enable private browsing (incognito), ensure no user data persistence
Test password masking in input fields and browser logs
Request export of all user data to CSV (GDPR Right to Data Portability)
Verify declining marketing cookies consent stops tracker auto-loading
